collection.description: Explorers find plans for a woven vessel meant to fly above the sea under a heated envelope.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Explorers find plans for a great woven vessel that appears intended to travel above the sea, held aloft by a vast heated envelope.

choices.label: Involve the village council and apprentices.

o1.name: Outcome 1
o1.text: A small unmanned model rises, astonishing the village.

o2.name: Outcome 2
o2.text: The first trial stays stubbornly on the ground.

o3.name: Outcome 3
o3.text: An elder calls the contraption a canoe that has forgotten the ocean.
